messages.text: Stokes fires Durham to One-Day Cup victory over Essex in Gay's absence

metadata.summary: Ben Stokes made a quickfire 43 to help Durham to a 20-run victory over Essex in their One-Day Cup Group B match at Darlington despite the absence of England Test opener Emilio Gay.

messages.text: Hibs win at Rangers as McInnes remains winless

metadata.summary: Derek McInnes is still looking for his first win as Rangers manager after Hibernian netted an injury-time winner to triumph 2-1 at Ibrox.

messages.text: Samangan stars in Prix Maurice de Gheest

metadata.summary: Samangan gave Francis-Henri Graffard another Group One success with victory in the ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest at Deauville.

messages.text: 'Exciting' Sun Goddess looks the part in Phoenix Stakes

metadata.summary: Sun Goddess came from last to first to provide Aidan O’Brien with his 18th win in the Keeneland Phoenix Stakes at the Curragh.

messages.text: Liverpool throw away another 2-0 lead as Iraola loses first Anfield game

metadata.summary: Liverpool threw away another pre-season lead as Monaco came from behind to win 3-2 in Andoni Iraola's first game in charge at Anfield.

messages.text: Arsenal concede 'poor goals' as Dortmund win Emirates Cup

metadata.summary: Arsenal produced more comical defending in pre-season as Borussia Dortmund won 3-2 in north London to win the Emirates Cup.

messages.text: Late heartache for Hull as Huang snatches PIF London title

metadata.summary: Charley Hull surrendered the lead with a double-bogey on the 17th as Anna Huang stormed to a two-shot victory at the PIF London Championship at Centurion Club.

messages.text: Sunrisers Leeds dominate Welsh Fire to remain in eliminator contention

metadata.summary: Sunrisers Leeds kept themselves in contention for The Hundred eliminator while dumping Welsh Fire out of the women's competition in a one-sided contest at Headingley.

metadata.summary: Hogh runs rampant with first-half hat-trick for Celtic.

messages.text: Five-time Super League winner Makinson to retire at end of 2026 campaign

metadata.summary: Tommy Makinson has announced he will retire from rugby league at the end of the current 2026 Super League campaign.

messages.text: McInnes on Rangers' woe: We're not as bad as people think

metadata.summary: Derek McInnes believes Rangers "aren't as bad as people think" despite his winless start to life at Ibrox.

messages.text: Marsh fifty helps SunRisers ease past Welsh Fire in The Hundred

metadata.summary: Mitchell Marsh's half-century and three wickets from Brydon Carse helped SunRisers Leeds take a big step towards the men's Hundred eliminator with a crushing 71-run victory over Welsh Fire.

messages.text: 'The first of many!' | Hogh opens Celtic account early on at Kilmarnock

metadata.summary: Kasper Hogh scored his first Celtic goal inside the opening two minutes of Celtic’s away match at Kilmarnock.

messages.text: Thorslund ends Johnson's undisputed run to become world champion again

metadata.summary: Dina Thorslund is a world champion again after ending Cherneka Johnson's undisputed run to cap an emotional return to the sport.
